dog.description_text:
Tippy is a 5 year old mixed breed who weighs around 49 lbs. If there's one thing this sweet girl can't get enough of, it's pets! Tippy loves getting attention and isn't shy about asking for more once she's comfortable with you. She can be a little unsure when meeting new people, but give her some time to get to know you and she'll soon be asking for affection.

Tippy is still figuring out her new life and would love a patient adopter who can show her the ropes and help her build her confidence at her own pace. There's a very affectionate girl behind that initial shyness, and we can't wait for her to find a family she can shower with love!

Registered adopters interested in Tippy can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
